// @version=5
indicator("Lucid 8 — RS Sprint", overlay=true, max_labels_count=500, max_lines_count=500)

// Evaluation sprint on relative strength. At 10:00, 11:00, 13:00 and 14:30 ET
// (close of the bar ending then), the first time that
//   NQ return since the 09:30 open - ES return since the open > +0.15%
//   and price is above the session VWAP           -> LONG
//   the difference is below -0.15% and price is below VWAP -> SHORT
// one trade is taken: target 0.20% of price, stop 0.40%, flat at 15:55.
// Size so the stop costs at most "Max loss" (~$1,000 win at $1,900).
// Three wins pass (best day ~1/3 of profit); one loss ends the attempt.
// NQ 2018-2025 with costs: 48% (2018-21) / 52% (2022-25) of attempts pass,
// ~13 trading days to a pass on average, vs 36% for the plain 09:31 long.
// Use a 1-minute MNQ chart.
// Finishing trade (2026-10-23): enter your evaluation profit so far in
// "Eval profit so far". From +$2,100 (drawdown locked at +$100), when the
// target is at most one win away, the size shrinks so the win just finishes
// +$3,000 (+$60) and a loss cannot end the account. Two-account plan
// 2018-21 / 2022-25: first funded after 6.9 / 6.3 days instead of 7.6 / 6.9
// (scripts/two_win_sprint.py, two_win_pair.py; faster in all four eras 2010-25).

maxLoss = input.float(1900.0, "Max loss per trade ($)")
winCap   = input.float(1450.0, "Max win per trade ($, day profit cap)")
evalPnl  = input.float(0.0, "Eval profit so far ($) - for the finishing trade")
rsThr   = input.float(0.15, "Relative strength threshold (%)") / 100.0
tgtPct  = input.float(0.20, "Target (% of price)") / 100.0
stpPct  = input.float(0.40, "Stop (% of price)") / 100.0
ptValue = input.float(2.0, "$ per point per contract (MNQ = 2)")
maxCts  = input.int(40, "Max contracts")
esSym   = input.string("CME_MINI:ES1!", "ES symbol")

esC = request.security(esSym, timeframe.period, close, lookahead=barmerge.lookahead_off)
esO = request.security(esSym, timeframe.period, open, lookahead=barmerge.lookahead_off)

oMin = hour(time, "America/New_York") * 60 + minute(time, "America/New_York")
cMin = hour(time_close, "America/New_York") * 60 + minute(time_close, "America/New_York")
is1 = timeframe.period == "1"
isCheck = cMin == 600 or cMin == 660 or cMin == 780 or cMin == 870

var float nqOpen = na
var float esOpen = na
var float pv = 0.0
var float vv = 0.0
var bool traded = false
if oMin == 570
    nqOpen := open
    esOpen := esO
    pv := 0.0
    vv := 0.0
    traded := false
inRth = cMin > 570 and cMin <= 960 and not na(nqOpen)
if inRth
    pv += hlc3 * volume
    vv += volume
vw = vv > 0 ? pv / vv : na
rs = inRth and not na(esOpen) ? (close / nqOpen - 1.0) - (esC / esOpen - 1.0) : na

var float e = na
var float tp = na
var float sl = na
var int cts = 0
var int dir = 0
var int entBar = na
var line eL = na
var line tL = na
var line sL = na

if is1 and isCheck and barstate.isconfirmed and not traded and na(e) and not na(rs)
    sig = rs > rsThr and close > vw ? 1 : rs < -rsThr and close < vw ? -1 : 0
    if sig != 0
        traded := true
        dir := sig
        entBar := bar_index
        e := close
        tp := close * (1.0 + dir * tgtPct)
        sl := close * (1.0 - dir * stpPct)
        lossPer = math.abs(e - sl) * ptValue
        winPer = math.abs(tp - e) * ptValue
        cts := math.min(maxCts, math.max(1, math.min(int(math.floor(maxLoss / lossPer)), int(math.floor(winCap / winPer)))))
        // finishing trade (2026-10-23): once the profit is >= $2,100 (drawdown locked at +$100)
        // and the target is <= one win away, size the win to just finish (+$60), never
        // risking the account: two big wins + this small one pass, faster than three big ones
        if evalPnl >= 2100.0 and 3000.0 - evalPnl <= winCap
            fin = math.max(1, int(math.ceil((3000.0 - evalPnl + 60.0) / (winPer - 2.0))))
            safe = math.max(1, int(math.floor((evalPnl - 100.0 - 50.0) / (lossPer + 3.0))))
            cts := math.min(cts, math.min(fin, safe))
        eL := line.new(bar_index, e, bar_index + 30, e, color=color.yellow, width=2, extend=extend.right)
        tL := line.new(bar_index, tp, bar_index + 30, tp, color=color.lime, width=2, extend=extend.right)
        sL := line.new(bar_index, sl, bar_index + 30, sl, color=color.red, width=2, extend=extend.right)
        label.new(bar_index, dir == 1 ? low : high, "RS " + (dir == 1 ? "LONG " : "SHORT ") + str.tostring(cts) + " MNQ\nRS " + str.tostring(rs * 100, "#.##") + "%  win $" + str.tostring(cts * math.abs(tp - e) * ptValue, "#") + " / loss $" + str.tostring(cts * math.abs(e - sl) * ptValue, "#"), color=dir == 1 ? color.blue : color.purple, textcolor=color.white, style=dir == 1 ? label.style_label_up : label.style_label_down, size=size.normal)

if not na(e) and bar_index > entBar
    rsn = ""
    px = 0.0
    if (dir == 1 and low <= sl) or (dir == -1 and high >= sl)
        rsn := "LOSS"
        px := dir == 1 ? math.min(sl, open) : math.max(sl, open)
    else if (dir == 1 and high >= tp) or (dir == -1 and low <= tp)
        rsn := "WIN"
        px := dir == 1 ? math.max(tp, open) : math.min(tp, open)
    else if cMin >= 955
        rsn := "EOD"
        px := close
    if rsn != ""
        usd = cts * dir * (px - e) * ptValue
        line.set_x2(eL, bar_index)
        line.set_x2(tL, bar_index)
        line.set_x2(sL, bar_index)
        line.set_extend(eL, extend.none)
        line.set_extend(tL, extend.none)
        line.set_extend(sL, extend.none)
        label.new(bar_index, px, "RS " + rsn + "\n" + (usd >= 0 ? "+$" : "-$") + str.tostring(math.abs(usd), "#"), color=usd >= 0 ? color.green : color.red, textcolor=color.white, style=label.style_label_down, size=size.small)
        e := na

plot(inRth ? vw : na, "VWAP", color=color.new(color.aqua, 30))

var table tb = table.new(position.top_right, 1, 2, bgcolor=color.new(color.black, 30))
if barstate.islast
    msg = not is1 ? "RS SPRINT: use a 1-minute chart" : not na(e) ? "IN TRADE: " + (dir == 1 ? "LONG " : "SHORT ") + str.tostring(cts) + " MNQ  TP " + str.tostring(tp, format.mintick) + "  SL " + str.tostring(sl, format.mintick) : traded ? "done for today" : "waiting: checks 10:00 / 11:00 / 13:00 / 14:30"
    table.cell(tb, 0, 0, msg, text_color=color.white, bgcolor=not is1 ? color.red : not na(e) ? color.new(color.orange, 20) : color.new(color.gray, 50))
    table.cell(tb, 0, 1, "NQ vs ES since open: " + (na(rs) ? "-" : str.tostring(rs * 100, "#.##") + "%") + (na(vw) ? "" : (close > vw ? "  above VWAP" : "  below VWAP")), text_color=color.white)
extra: Pojistka: když má účet B otevřený obchod z 09:31 opačným směrem, signál na A přeskoč (hedging). Edge ověřen i v 2010–17. Funded noha (kandidát): Target 1,25 % / Stop 1,25 %.
